decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun within 3 years from the date of this permission.

Reason: To accord with the provisions of Section 92 (1) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.
Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (PP-19PC-01, PP-19PC-02, design and access statement, PP-19PC-03, PP-19PC-04, daylight sunlight report, planting and maintenance specification, fire statement, drainage strategy
 
Received: 16/06/2025

Biodiversity net gain report and calculation, BNG small sites metric

Received: 17/07/2025

Energy and sustainability assessment REV B

Received: 09/09/2025) 

therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Reason: To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those shown on the approved plans. 

Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area
Condition : 4 - A)	The development shall be implemented in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy.

B)	Prior to first occupation of the development hereby approved, the relevant carbon offset payment shall have been made and evidence (e.g. photographs, installation contracts and As-Built certificates under the Standard Assessment Procedure/National Calculation Method) shall be submitted to the local planning authority and approved in writing to show that the development has been constructed in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy, and any subsequent approved revisions, and achieved a 72% reduction in emissions. 

Reason: In order to ensure that the development makes the fullest contribution to minimising carbon dioxide emissions.
Condition : 5 - The development shall have been constructed to achieve an internal water use of 105 litres/person/day or less.

Reason: In order to protect and conserve water supplies and resources.
Condition : 6 - Prior to first occupation of any part of the development the hard and soft landscaping shall be carried out in full in accordance with the approved details PP-19PC-04 Received: 16/06/2025 and maintained in accordance with such thereafter. 

Reason: In order to ensure a satisfactory appearance of the site and the area and to promote biodiversity
Condition : 7 - The cycle parking shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details PP-19PC-04 Received: 16/06/2025 and maintained in accordance with such thereafter. 
The approved facilities shall be fully implemented prior to occupation and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction.

Reason: To support sustainable transport objectives
Condition : 8 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) 1995 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order), no enlargement of the premises or any additional structures/buildings/enclosures within the curtilage of the site shall be carried out, other than as shown in the approved drawings, and no additional floor space shall be formed within the building(s) hereby permitted by means of internal horizontal division (new mezzanine level) without prior written approval of the local planning authority.

Reason: To protect neighbours' living conditions and the character and appearance of the conservation area and to prevent over-intensive use of the site. 
Condition : 9 - Prior to the first commencement of the hereby approved development, a Biodiversity Gain Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, the Plan shall include; 
(a) information about the steps taken or to be taken to minimise the adverse effect of the development on the biodiversity of the onsite habitat and any other habitat, 
(b) the pre-development biodiversity value of the onsite habitat, 
(c) the post-development biodiversity value of the onsite habitat, 
(d) any registered offsite biodiversity gain allocated to the development and the biodiversity value of that gain in relation to the development, 
(e) any biodiversity credits purchased for the development, and 
(f) such other matters as the Secretary of State may by regulations specify. The development shall thereafter be carried out in accordance with the approved Plan prior to the first occupation of the development. Any habitats created or enhanced on-site and off-site in accordance with the Biodiversity Gain Plan must be maintained thereafter for a minimum of 30 years. 

Reason. In the interests of improving Biodiversity and in accordance with The Town and Country Planning Act 1990, Section 90A, Schedule 7A.
Condition : 10 - Notwithstanding the details on the approved plans, prior to commencement of groundworks (excluding site investigations and demolition), the applicant shall have submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval in writing a final detailed drainage design, including drawings and supporting calculations and an updated Drainage Assessment Form to be reviewed and approved by the Lead Local Flood Authority. The drainage hierarchy shall make use of green infrastructure technology to comply with the hierarchy set out in London Plan Policy SI3 and the runoff rate must not exceed 2 litres/second. The results of infiltration testing shall be provided to confirm whether this is suitable. A detailed management plan confirming routine maintenance tasks for all drainage components shall also be submitted and approved which demonstrates how the drainage system is to be maintained for the lifetime of the development. The development shall be carried out in strict compliance with the approved details.

Reason: To prevent the risk of flooding to and from the site 
Condition : 11 - No building hereby permitted shall be occupied until evidence (photographs and installation contracts) is submitted to demonstrate that the sustainable drainage scheme for the site has been completed in accordance with the submitted details. The sustainable drainage scheme shall be managed and maintained thereafter in accordance with the agreed management and maintenance plan for all the proposed drainage components.

Reason: To comply with the National Standards for Sustainable Drainage Systems
Condition : 12 - The windows formed in the side elevations shall be obscure-glazed and non-opening below 1.7 metres above internal floor level. The windows shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than in accordance with the requirements of this condition. 
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' privacy
Condition : 13 - No additional windows or openings shall be formed in the side and front elevations of the development hereby permitted.
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' privacy and the character and appearance of the area.
description: Erection of a two storey house with associated landscaping, private amenity space, car parking, cycle and refuse storage.
